name: AI Provider: Universal
description: Universal multi-instance AI provider for the Drupal AI module: OpenAI-compatible servers and their models as config entities, ten+ backend plugins, plus optional smart routing, fact-check and content-governance submodules.
project_description: AI Provider: Universal is a multi-instance provider plugin ('universal') for the Drupal AI (drupal/ai) ecosystem. Instead of one hard-coded endpoint, it models each remote inference service as an ai_universal_server config entity (backend plugin id, host/port, Key-entity API key, timeout, operation-type filter, per-server daily request/token limits) and each discovered model as an ai_universal_model config entity (cost rates, quality tier, context length, sampling and extra-parameter overrides, capability tags). It ships a plugin type, AiServerBackend, with twelve implementations covering OpenAI-compatible servers (llama.cpp, vLLM, LM Studio, Ollama, Groq, OpenRouter, Fireworks, Hugging Face, LiteLLM, DeepSeek, amazee.ai, xAI/Grok) and a native Anthropic Messages backend; other modules can contribute further backends without patching the module. Model entity ids use dot-separated 'server.model' form for compatibility with AI core and ai_search. API credentials are always resolved through the Key module. Three optional submodules add value on top of the provider: ai_provider_universal_router (cost-aware smart routing to the cheapest capable model with a decision log), ai_provider_universal_factcheck (claim-level fact verification, AI-writing and plagiarism detection, scheduled node scans) and ai_provider_universal_governance (AI Act Art. 50 transparency: guardrail defaults, disclosure suffixes, AI-origin provenance events). Requires Drupal ^11.1 || ^12, PHP ^8.3, drupal/ai ^1.3 and drupal/key.
